summary: Iteration 2 social features (guest onboarding, friends/rivals, co-lobby, shareable recap) verified. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_social_features.py (guest creation returns token + friend_code; /auth/me and /profile expose friend_code + friends_count; friends list starts empty; POST /friends/add mutually adds both users; own-code -> 400; unknown code -> 404; duplicate add -> 400; case-insensitive code accepted; two guests joining within the 8s window land in the SAME match_id with humans>=2; POST /match/{id}/leave triggers results payload with all required fields won/placement/kills/xp_gained/bonus_xp/friend_kos/rival_kos/ko_names, and progression persists matches_played+xp). Iteration 1 regression suite (test_panic_button.py 20/20) is unaffected. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Auth screen shows NO email/password inputs -- only callsign; ENTER THE ARENA navigates to Play menu; header has friends-btn (account-group icon); Friends screen renders my-friend-code, invite-btn (SHARE INVITE), friend-code-input, add-friend-btn, and squad list; adding a valid code created out-of-band via /api/auth/guest displays 'Added <name>!' and appends to YOUR SQUAD (1). Lobby screen contains NO 'human' word (only '<n> / 100 operatives'). Match HUD loads with danger% + remaining count + panic-button; presses reduce alive count. Results/recap UI path not exercised by natural presses (human stayed alive), but code inspection confirms testIDs recap-card, share-recap-btn, return-lobby-btn are wired, KO bonus row uses friend_kos/rival_kos correctly, and backend results shape is verified in the pytest suite.

issues: (pre-existing from iter1) Custom TTF fonts fail to decode on the Expo web preview proxy — falls back to system font, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: (pre-existing from iter1) Uses prop 'pointerEvents="none"' -> 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:283

action_items: (carry-over) Migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:283.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate_friend_code() uses a 30-attempt collision loop over a 32^6 space (~1B) — safe; final uuid fallback is fine but should also collision-check ideally. Non-blocking.
server.py add_friend does two sequential updates (self + target) with no transaction; a mid-flight failure would leave asymmetric friendship. Acceptable given non-critical social data.
game.py MatchManager.persist_player uses $addToSet rivals=$each others INSIDE the same update with $inc/$max/$set — Mongo accepts this. Good.
auth.tsx: no rate limiting on /auth/guest — device could spam create accounts. Non-blocking for MVP.
friends.tsx: input auto-uppercases via autoCapitalize="characters" AND client uppercases before send; server also uppercases — good defense in depth.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke steps for new social flows; results/recap UI verified via code + backend, not via live UI (human stayed alive during natural play)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral guest users created via POST /api/auth/guest during each test run; no persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://button-battle-4.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Use POST /auth/guest {username} — no email/password anywhere. Friend codes are 6 chars from 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789' (no ambiguous chars); accepted case-insensitively. To co-lobby two humans, POST /match/join for both within ~8s. To reach results, POST /match/{id}/leave once phase=='active' — do NOT wait for a full 100-player match. Results include friend_kos/rival_kos/bonus_xp/ko_names — friend/rival KO bonuses are probabilistic during natural play, so main agent verifies them deterministically in unit tests, not via live UI.
